watches.name: Model Three Special Edition - Blue Dial / SS Case
watches.description: **This colour is sold out, but red and purple dial options will be available soon! ** This limited edition timepiece has been meticulously crafted to celebrate British Watchmakers’ Day 2025, featuring a newly designed blue, white, and red dial — a colour scheme that naturally evokes a strong connection to British heritage and institutions. Staying true to Alkin’s ethos of creating robust, functional tool watches, the Special Edition distills every element down to achieve a simple yet visually balanced design that offers maximum legibility, functionality, and versatility. This refined aesthetic is elevated with the introduction of polished Arabic numerals, markers, and a bold sword-and-arrow handset — marking an evolution in Alkin’s distinctive ‘house style.’ The applied numbers and markers are paired with a brushed sandwich dial, creating a sense of depth that catches the light from every angle. This effect is further enhanced by the circular brushing on the top dial and a vertical brush finish on the lower dial. The use of sapphire crystal, Super-LumiNova and the Miyota 9039 automatic movement all demonstrates the central alkin commitment to quality and functionality. These firm choices in materials and movements exemplify our unwavering pledge to crafting timepieces of the highest caliber while maintaining an accessible price point. A ceramic insert is house within the unidirectional rotating bezel, with the numbers and markers being laser etched and then filled with BGW9 Super-LlumiNova. All versions of the Model Three will ship on a brushed stainless steel bracelet with solid endlinks and a milled clasp. Adjustment links are secured by screw pins and a six stop micro adjustment allows you to achieve a perfect fit. The Special Edition is limited to 40 pieces. Specifications Case: 316L stainless steel Finish: Brushed stainless steel Movement: Miyota 9039 Lume: Super-LumiNova BGW9 Lens: Sapphire with AR coating Strap: 316L stainless steel bracelet with solid endlinks Crown: 3.5mm x 6.5mm screw-down Bezel: External unidirectional Dimensions: 40.5mm x 48.5mm Lug width: 20mm Thickness: 12.5mm Water resistance: 2 00m Extras: Two-slot vegetable-tanned leather travel pouch

All versions of the Model Three will ship on a brushed stainless steel bracelet with solid endlinks and a milled clasp. Adjustment links are secured by screw pins and a six stop micro adjustment allows you to achieve a perfect fit. watches.name: Model Three Dual Time - Yellow Dial / SS Case
watches.description: A harmonious blend of form and function, the model three dual time strikes the perfect balance between elegance and reliability, making it an ideal companion as a smart everyday choice or for those seeking a timepiece that effortlessly transitions between time zones. Both the hands and the applied markers on the dual time share a ‘stadium shape’ design language, giving the watch a much softer look and feel to other alkin models. A sense of ‘depth’ on the dial is achieved with the applied markers raised up from the dial and a circle cut out in the centre top dial, dropping down to the bottom dial. Unlike previous alkin models, which were only available in more utilitarian colourways, the dual time model was specifically designed as a platform to experiment with vibrant colours and striking dial finishes, while remaining true to the essence of an alkin watch. The brushed stainless bezel insert employs the 12-hour dual-time feature, which helps you tell the time in a 2nd time zone. The numbers are laser etched into the insert and filled with black paint, while the 12 o’clock pip is filled with BGW 9 Super-LumiNova. The use of sapphire crystal, Super-LumiNova and the Miyota 9039 automatic movement all demonstrates the central alkin commitment to quality and functionality. These firm choices in materials and movements exemplify our unwavering pledge to crafting timepieces of the highest caliber while maintaining an accessible price point. All versions of the Model Three will ship on a brushed stainless steel bracelet with solid endlinks and a milled clasp. Adjustment links are secured by screw pins and a six stop micro adjustment allows you to achieve a perfect fit. watches.name: Model Two - Black Dial / SS Case
watches.description: The model two takes inspiration from the traditional dual crown diver archetype, but brings it up-to-date in a form that is simple, modern and robust. This update is followed through in the mechanics of the watch, which employs screw down crowns and a depth rating of 300m, instead of a true super compressor system. The use of a double-domed sapphire crystal, Super-LumiNova BGW9 and the Miyota 9039 automatic movement further demonstrates alkin’s central commitment to quality and functionality. All elements of the watch have been distilled down to create a visually balanced piece that offers maximum legibility, functionality and versatility. The 41mm brushed stainless steel case has a utilitarian style with proportions that give it a presence on the wrist without being too bulky. The short lugs (48mm overall) reach down to hug the wrist, helping to balance out the slightly larger case diameter. To once again reflect the updated nod to tradition, the ‘hatching’ design on the crown that controls the bezel, has been laser etched, instead of machined. To create a sense of ‘depth’ in the dial design, the model two employs a sandwich construction, with the hour indices cut out to expose the lower dial. This is further enhanced by a stepped rotating inner bezel being set 1.4mm above the face of the dial, creating a more contemporary and robust look. The model two will ship on a brushed stainless steel bracelet with fully articulating solid links, solid endlinks and a milled clasp. Adjustment links are secured by screw pins and a six stop micro adjustment allows you to achieve a perfect fit. Specifications Case: 316L stainless steel Finish: Brushed stainless steel Movement: Miyota 9039 Lume: Super-LumiNova BGW9 Lens: Sapphire with AR coating Strap: 316L stainless steel bracelet with solid endlinks Crown: 3.5mm x 6.5mm screw-down Bezel: Internal bi-directional Dimensions: 41mm x 48mm Lug width: 20mm Thickness: 12.8mm Water resistance: 300m Extras: Two-slot vegetable-tanned leather travel pouch Follow these links to Scottish Watches and the Watch Report for an independent reviews of the Model Two.
